plain.li: Killing {ABOUT_nameDef} in a locked cell, unarmed, isn't justice.
If we start executing prisoners, where does it stop?
I stitched {ABOUT_nameDef} up myself, and I won't stand and watch {ABOUT_objective} die.
[afterraid] We're all still angry about yesterday, so this isn't the day to decide who dies.

warm.li: {OTHER_nameDef}, please, I know why you're angry, but this won't help.
{ABOUT_nameDef} has family somewhere, waiting for {ABOUT_objective} to come home.
[trait:Kind] I'll feed {ABOUT_nameDef} from my own plate if that's the problem, only don't do this.

blunt.li: If you want blood, {OTHER_nameDef}, go hunt a muffalo and leave the prisoner be.
You'll have to go through me first.

cheerful.li: Don't kill the prisoner, {ABOUT_nameDef} and I were just starting to get along!

gloomy.li: We keep killing people who've already lost, and I don't recognize us anymore.

cold.li: An execution upsets the others and loses us the ransom, which is poor value.
{ABOUT_nameDef} could be recruited, sold or ransomed. A corpse can only be buried.

plain.li: Let {ABOUT_nameDef} go, and {ABOUT_pronoun}'ll be back with friends and a map of our weak spots.
{OTHER_nameDef} wants to free {ABOUT_nameDef}, who was trying to kill us not long ago?
[afterraid] Their blood is still on the floor, and it's too soon to let anyone go.

warm.li: You mean well, {OTHER_nameDef}, but I've seen what people like {ABOUT_nameDef} do.

blunt.li: Free {ABOUT_nameDef}, then, and you can explain it to whoever {ABOUT_pronoun} kills next.
[trait:Bloodlust] I had plans for {ABOUT_nameDef}, and don't ask what they were.

cheerful.li: I'm all for second chances, but not for people who came here to rob us!

gloomy.li: They thank you, walk off, and come back with more of their own.

cold.li: Releasing {ABOUT_nameDef} hands our layout and our numbers to the enemy for nothing.
[trait:Psychopath] We've put a lot of food into {ABOUT_nameDef}, and I'd like a return on it.

plain.li: I miss {ABOUT_nameDef} too, but storming a settlement for one person could cost us three.
We're farmers and cooks, not an army.
Whoever goes in after {ABOUT_nameDef} might not come back either.

blunt.li: {ABOUT_nameDef} is gone, so stop planning a war we'll lose.

gloomy.li: I'm sorry, but after this long it may already be too late.

cold.li: Getting {ABOUT_nameDef} back means risking several of us to save one.
[trait:Psychopath] We can take someone with the same skills from the next raid, and cheaper.
